content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online with crypto payments represents a paradigm shift for creators in markets with limited access to mainstream payment processors. Unlike platforms like Gumroad that take a hefty 10% on sales, using NOWPayments allows you to retain 99.5% of your revenue. This difference is not just financial; it empowers creators to maintain ownership over their work and the sales process, fostering a direct relationship with their audience. The infrastructure enables creators to bypass conventional restrictions, ensuring they can monetize their craft without barriers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this infrastructure is a combination of free and paid tools that work seamlessly together. You can host your digital products on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, utilizing backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the crypto transaction instantly, confirming payment on-chain. This architecture not only automates delivery but also guarantees that creators own their data, ensuring that they are not beholden to third-party platforms. This sovereignty over the entire process is critical for creators who are tired of fees and restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, where conventional payment options are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Musicians, beat makers, and other digital product creators can benefit from this infrastructure, as it provides a clear path to sell their work directly to consumers. By leveraging crypto payments, these creators can engage with a global audience while avoiding the fees and complexities associated with traditional payment systems. This approach fosters a sense of independence and empowerment that is vital in today's digital economy.
Say goodbye to 10% fees — retain more revenue with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack comprises several key components that work in harmony. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting platform, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend processes. Order storage is handled via Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery takes place through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The payment confirmation is managed by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of just 0.5%. This cohesive architecture ensures that creators can set up their online store quickly and efficiently, enabling them to focus on what they do best: creating.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your beats online, first choose your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, and prepare your files for delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. By following these steps and utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you gain access to all the blueprints and templates necessary to build and scale your digital commerce stack efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by leveraging a sovereign commerce stack. This includes using platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. This approach not only eliminates platform fees but ensures you retain full ownership of your sales and customer data.
Full ownership means no third-party interference in your sales.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
